product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI agents to SMBs that help them get discovered across AI search, Google, and paid channels and turn that interest into qualified inbound leads.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage description says Gushwork's AI agents help SMBs generate qualified inbound leads; the homepage also describes discovery across AI search, Google, and paid channels.

pricing_page.notes: The cited page is Gushwork's public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage's customer testimonials identify Midwest Power Products, Source Equipment, and Fraxtional. | named_customers.0: The testimonial section names Midwest Power Products as a customer. | named_customers.1: The testimonial section names Source Equipment as a customer. | named_customers.2: The testimonial section names Fraxtional as a customer.

employee_band.notes: The matched company record gives an employee count of 80, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The matched company record lists Lewes as the location city. | hq_country: The record matching the gushwork.ai website lists the location country as United States.

founded_year.notes: The company record matching gushwork.ai lists founded_year as 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains SEO and marketing-oriented posts, including a guide about AI search engines; the reviewed index did not show two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage content presents product and demo information but no documentation or help-center link; no public multi-article documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The November 2026 job-board listing enumerates open roles, from Performance Marketing Manager through Account Executive - US Sales, without an AI, ML, data-science, research-scientist, NLP, or LLM title.

model_provider.notes: A report quotes Gushwork's CEO saying the company uses Anthropic's model heavily and also uses OpenAI's model.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy refers to GDPR as a legal framework for explaining processing bases; it does not claim a certification. The reviewed legal/security text did not establish a public certification claim, so the list is empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The matched company record and the company's announcement identify the latest round as Seed. | funding_date: The company record and announcement date the most recent round to February 26, 2026, represented as 2026-02. | funding_amount_usd: The matched company record and Gushwork's funding announcement identify a $9 million round.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced its Seed round on February 26, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive - US Sales posting includes an application link, so the company is hiring for a qualifying role.

launched_6mo.notes: Gushwork announced that its AI Editor was live and available to customers starting June 2, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership listing identifies only two co-founders and does not provide a complete dated executive roster. A CTO profile gives an April 2025 start date, outside the 12-month window; no verified in-window C-level/VP change was established, so this remains unknown.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Account Executive job post names Zoho, HubSpot, and Salesforce as CRM systems for which proficiency is relevant; this is a visible CRM-stack signal, not proof that all three are deployed internally. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job post explicitly names Zoho as a CRM for which proficiency is relevant. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job post explicitly names HubSpot as a CRM for which proficiency is relevant. | crm_stack_signal.2: The job post explicitly names Salesforce as a CRM for which proficiency is relevant.
